rationale: The mass is geometrically coherent as a single object across views, but it is not yet a plausible gymnasium. The dominant form reads as a faceted, aggressively stepped/pinched sculptural prism rather than one usable long-span hall with subordinate support. The roof/section language does not express span or daylight; instead it breaks into repetitive triangular ridges and slanted planes that feel arbitrary and semantically closer to a roof sculpture than a sports hall. There is almost no public void, court, undercut, or entry seam responding to access, so the ground condition is weak despite the object’s containment. Repair integrity is good because the form appears closed and not visibly self-colliding, but program fit fails because the visible mass suppresses the gymnasium’s required clear-span and service-hierarchy logic.
